readme: Directions (probe, write, resid, bytes16) were fitted ONLY at fitted_site positions (the byte before a word that follows a determiner, CAL stories 0-799). Elsewhere a projection is out of domain and should be greyed, not read. z_readings are (projection - mean) / sd of the same projection over the fitting sites, per layer and direction, so layers and directions compare. resid = the writing direction minus its part in the 16 next-byte forecast directions (the probe is NOT removed from it). next_byte_forecast = the z-scored reading along the forecast direction of the byte that actually comes next, when it is one of the 16; else null. A write's length is not its effect (KS-DIRECT-ONLY).
